S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.

subtypes.Chronic Worry: Worry occurs more days than not for at least 6 months.
subtypes.Generalized Worry: Worry is not confined to specific topics but spreads to various domains like work, school, family, and finances.
subtypes.Catastrophizing: Jumping to conclusions that minor mistakes or events will lead to irreversible disasters.
subtypes.Intolerance of Uncertainty: Unable to tolerate future uncertainty, trapped in 'what if' questions.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.

subtypes.Failure to Control: Unable to regulate worry despite efforts to stop or distract oneself.
subtypes.Intrusive Worry: Worries suddenly intrude into the mind and interfere with focus while doing other tasks.
subtypes.Chaining of Worry: One worry triggers another in a chain reaction, escalating to catastrophic thoughts.

S058.name: Restlessness_Tension
S058.description: Restlessness, or feeling keyed up or on edge.

subtypes.Feeling Keyed Up: Feeling anxious and wound up like a spring, unable to stay still.
subtypes.Physical Tension: The entire body feels stiff and tense, unable to relax.
subtypes.Nervousness: Nerves are on edge, being startled easily by minor sounds or stimuli.

S059.name: Concentration_Difficulty
S059.description: Difficulty concentrating or mind going blank.

subtypes.Interference by Worry: Unable to focus on the task at hand because worries keep surfacing.
subtypes.Inability to Sustain Attention: Attention is scattered due to anxiety, making it hard to focus on one thing for long.
subtypes.Mind Going Blank: Suddenly the mind goes empty or white, and no thoughts occur.

patient_info.stressor_event: Foreclosure on a mortgage or loan
patient_info.stressor: Anabella had co-signed a small condo loan with a cousin, seeing it as both a family investment and a step toward independence, but a run of reduced hours for her cousin and unexpected repair costs pushed the loan into foreclosure proceedings. At first she treated it like another complex project, building spreadsheets between computer-support tickets and community tech mentoring, but over the next nine months her worry spread from the foreclosure to work performance, family disappointment, finances, and future plans. Her sleep became unreliable, she felt keyed up during help-desk escalations and dance nights alike, and she began losing focus during scripting tasks and bilingual support calls that she normally handled with precision. She sought psychiatric care after her primary care clinician, whom she saw for persistent fatigue and insomnia, recognized the pattern of generalized, uncontrollable worry and referred her for evaluation.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.
S027.manifestation: Most nights I get into bed exhausted, but my brain keeps replaying loan notices, work tickets, and things I might have missed until it's 2 or 3 in the morning, and even when I sleep I wake up feeling like I barely rested.

S056.name: Excessive_Anxiety_Worry
S056.description: Excessive anxiety and worry (expectant apprehension) occurring persistently about a number of events or activities.
S056.manifestation: My worry doesn't stay on the condo anymore; it jumps from whether my cousin is upset with me, to whether I'll make a mistake on a support call, to how I'll ever save money or move forward with my life.

S057.name: Uncontrollable_Worry
S057.description: The subjective experience of finding it difficult to stop or control the worry.
S057.manifestation: Even when I tell myself I've already checked the spreadsheet or sent the email, the thoughts keep looping, and one 'what if' turns into five more before I can pull myself back.

S058.name: Restlessness_Tension
S058.description: Restlessness, or feeling keyed up or on edge.
S058.manifestation: I came in because I feel wound up almost all the time, like my body is bracing for the next bad thing even when I'm just sitting at my desk or trying to enjoy dance night.

S059.name: Concentration_Difficulty
S059.description: Difficulty concentrating or mind going blank.
S059.manifestation: At work I'll be writing a script or helping someone in English or Spanish, and suddenly I'm staring at the screen because my mind has drifted to everything that could go wrong and I lose the thread.

functional_impairment.name: Functional Impairment
functional_impairment.manifestation: I've started falling behind on support tickets and double-checking simple tasks so much that coworkers have had to pick up the slack, and I've skipped several dance nights and mentoring sessions because I feel too overwhelmed to show up.

duration.name: Duration
duration.manifestation: This has been going on for about nine months, since the condo loan started moving toward foreclosure.
